name: app-black-onboarding-screens-with-white-buttons
title: Pure black onboarding flow with white selection cards and buttons
whatItIs: A black case-study board headed 'Onboarding Experience' with staggered phones: a gender choice with two large dark cards, a goal picker with checkbox rows, a subscription paywall with a gradient orb icon and monthly/yearly options, and a numeric daily goal stepper. Every screen ends with a white full-width button and a plain Back link.
whatItMeans: Serious, focused and premium; removing colour makes every choice feel deliberate.
techniques: Use only black, near-black and white with one single white primary button per screen.
Show progress as a short segmented line at the top with one segment tinted.
Make options large dark cards or rows with tiny checkboxes.
Give the paywall one glowing gradient icon as its only colour.
Stagger phones diagonally with tiny caption labels.

vocabulary.definition: A short bar split into steps showing onboarding position.
A large tappable block representing one option.
A control with plus and minus buttons around a number.
